asset.name: ToolExecutionCard
asset.description: The structured tool operation showing input summary, permission scope, and pending, running, progress, result, failure, retry, and cancellation, with expandable detail on demand.

requires.reason: Framing uses the shared card, which is a genuinely bounded object here.
Loading, empty, partial, stale, error, and offline presentation are delegated rather than reimplemented.
Certainty and urgency are expressed on the shared orthogonal axes rather than as one flat variant set.
Structured inputs and results render through the shared viewer.

rationale: Must distinguish will-run from did-run unambiguously. A card that renders a proposed call identically to a completed one is how users approve things they believed had already happened.
